images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 2241 Dorr Str

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a one-storey painted block corner building with a stepped parapet, a row of steel factory windows, a big overhead door on the side -- a neighbourhood garage or small shop among houses; a cyclist, utility poles

why.note: before zoning (Toledo 1920s), garages and shops stood on corners among the houses
